high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Economic Times App," as indicated by the app icon at the top left corner. The article's title reads, "How advanced satellites and machine learning solved the puzzle." The content discusses the use of the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) satellite to unravel a mystery. Key details from the text: The SWOT satellite is a joint mission between NASA and a French space agency, launched in December 2022. Unlike traditional satellites that scan narrow lines, SWOT uses Ka-band Radar Interferometer (KaRIn) technology to map wide swaths
